risks.title: Disruptions in the supply from third-party vendors
risks.score_rationale: The company relies heavily on third-party suppliers for raw materials and components, making it vulnerable to shortages and price increases. The current geopolitical tensions in the Middle East, Venezuela, and Ukraine aggravate this risk. (default score, subject to refinement)

risks.title: Cost volatility
risks.score_rationale: Costs of raw materials, components, and services are affected by numerous factors outside the company's control, such as tariffs, climate changes, and oil price fluctuations. (default score, subject to refinement)

risks.title: Geopolitical risks
risks.score_rationale: Geopolitical tensions, conflicts, and trade sanctions, particularly in the Middle East, Venezuela, and Ukraine, may disrupt supply chains and increase costs. (default score, subject to refinement)

risks.title: Increased competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a rapidly evolving market, with new entrants and established competitors that can offer similar products and services at lower prices. (default score, subject to refinement)

risks.title: Regulatory risks
risks.score_rationale: Compliance with regulatory requirements, including compliance with the EU Medical Devices Regulation (MDR), FDA approvals, and pre- and post-market clinical trials, poses significant challenges in terms of costs, timing, and uncertainty. (default score, subject to refinement)

risks.title: Operational disruptions
risks.score_rationale: Operational disruptions, such as production interruptions, quality issues, or failures of critical sterilization suppliers, may have a significant impact on operations and financial results. (default score, subject to refinement)
